scope: Fresh host HLS manifest and bounded actual media-segment demux; no board playback test

method.failed_direct_routes_retry: Retry through already configured proxy; proxy-required routes retry the same proxy
method.ffprobe_operation: Inspect demuxed stream information from a bounded real media segment; no ffmpeg frame decode or device playback.
method.selected_variant: Highest available variant at or below 1080p
method.media_sampling: First actual media segment; at most 8 MiB, plus fMP4 initialization at most 1 MiB

failure_counting_scope.final_source_categories: One category per unconfirmed source, using its final attempted route; mutually exclusive and sums to unconfirmed source count.
failure_counting_scope.attempt_categories: All attempts from unconfirmed sources; each attempt has one category, but a source appears twice and may appear in different categories.

limits: Network observations come from the build host, not the disconnected board.
Board cached channel list could not be compared.
Timeout, HTTP errors and resolver failures are observations, not proof of permanent dead streams.
Codec presence does not verify ARM32 runtime decode, smooth playback or A/V sync.
Codec-name matches do not check every profile, level, resolution or performance limit.
publication_scope: Aggregate counts and method only; channel identifiers, stream URLs, request data, proxy endpoint and raw logs are not included.
